g.title: Raw authentication event. Schema owned entirely by the domain.
Computed sliding-window behavioural features.
XGBoost risk score, top SHAP signals, routing decision.
The only function that crosses the domain → framework boundary. Translates three domain artifacts into framework contracts.
Generic ML evidence lattice: model identity, inference latency, label, feature_set, attribution.
Policy gate context: prompt_template_id, jurisdictions, risk_tier, template_vars. Required on ALL observations.
Fast-path provenance: model_id, risk_score, threshold_rule, feature_hash. Present only on FAST_PATH_ALLOW / FAST_PATH_BLOCK.
ROUTE_TO_GATE or FAST_PATH_ALLOW/BLOCK
Retrieves policy snippets (pgvector + ES). Invokes LLM with rendered prompt. Produces PolicyGateOutput.
Bypasses live LLM invocation. Enforces fast-path action directly. GateContext stored for shadow evaluation.
Deterministic rule-based action resolution. Re-runnable against cached gate output.
Complete audit record: raw event, reasoner context, gate context, rendered prompt, LLM response, enforcement decision.
